data_cutoff_note: Source pages did not expose a synchronized capture time for all observations. Provider update times are retained individually; no common point-in-time cutoff is asserted.
scope: Current single-venue spot quote, public derivatives-provider snapshots, and a retrospective ETF-flow/price predictiveness study. This is a research observation, not a forecast or feature-store admission.

market_snapshot.source_time_quality: The rendered API response did not expose an exact capture timestamp.
market_snapshot.interpretation: The ticker provides best bid/ask and displayed top-of-book quantities, not a full depth ladder. It is a single-venue observation and must not be treated as market-wide liquidity or executable size.

derivatives_snapshots.timestamp_quality: Page says data are read from Binance public market endpoints and cached for a short window, but does not expose an exact update time. The displayed next funding time is 2026-11-05T00:00:00Z, which had already passed by artifact capture; treat displayed live fields as time-uncertain.

derivatives_snapshots.exchange_scope: Seven exchanges for open interest; five exchanges for liquidations and account long/short ratio
measurement_notes: The provider states its long/short ratio is based on accounts, weighted by open interest; it is not a notional-long versus notional-short ratio.
Liquidations are a lower bound because exchanges publish only part of liquidation data in real time.
The provider states a 15-minute display delay.

binance_open_interest.treatment: Do not average. Provider timestamps, collection cadence and calculation methodology are not synchronized or fully disclosed.

cross_venue_scope.treatment: This is a broader exchange universe than the Binance-only Fibonomy figure; it is not a direct contradiction.

spot_vs_perpetual_prices.treatment: Different instruments, venues and observation times. Do not label the differences as executable arbitrage or synchronized basis.

etf_flow_predictiveness_study.source_type: Secondary retrospective analysis using SoSoValue daily ETF flow data and Binance USDT spot prices
etf_flow_predictiveness_study.key_counterevidence: In this sample, published daily XRP ETF flows had almost no rank correlation with the following 24-hour XRP return. The observed same-day relationship was also weak.
limitations: The available source extract does not disclose the full row-level dataset or sample count.
One third-party daily flow series and one Binance USDT price series do not establish a market-wide or causal relationship.
ETF flow publication and settlement timestamps may not align with the price-return window.
Zero-flow or missing-report days may be conflated.
The study covers less than one year and does not establish that longer horizons or issuer-level creation/redemption data are uninformative.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Rising open interest alongside positive 24-hour price change and positive funding may be consistent with new positions supporting the current trend.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The 76.4% long-account share and 3.24 account ratio on TradRadar indicate a crowded long account distribution; the account ratio is not notional exposure and does not prove directional continuation.

competing_hypotheses.statement: A concentrated long-account distribution may increase sensitivity to adverse price moves and liquidation cascades.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The current provider snapshots do not establish leverage distribution, collateral quality, liquidation prices or the size of unreported liquidations.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Daily aggregate ETF flows may be weak or non-predictive at the next-24-hour horizon.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The retrospective study uses one flow source and one price venue; issuer-level, intraday, multi-day and longer-horizon effects remain untested.
competing_hypotheses.status: COUNTERHYPOTHESIS TO TEST OUT OF SAMPLE

feature_admission.permitted_use: Research hypotheses, counterhypotheses and future test design only.
feature_admission.prohibited_use: Do not insert these observations into point-in-time model features, issue a directional forecast, or infer market-wide liquidity from one venue's ticker.

next_actions: Use the scheduled collector to capture synchronized raw spot, depth, funding, open-interest and liquidation source bytes with SHA-256 receipts and provider timestamps.
Reconcile Binance open interest across direct Binance endpoints and aggregators using the same timestamp and contract scope.
Separate account long/short ratios from notional long/short exposure and record liquidation coverage as a lower bound.

Acquire issuer-level ETF creations/redemptions and publication/settlement timestamps; test same-day, lead, lag and multi-day relationships chronologically against naive, momentum, mean-reversion and volatility baselines.
